data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in Defense & Security, carries a current post-money valuation of $4.4B following $825M+ in cumulative fundraising. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 18 same-sector comparable companies, supplemented by two public defense technology comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two quantitative methods inform the valuation range. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.3x step-up multiplier to the $4.4B Series F post-money, implying $5.7B at the next financing stage. Peer-median analysis across 18 Defense & Security comparables yields a median valuation of $2.4B, with observed range from $1.0B floor to $18.0B ceiling (exemplified by outliers Helsing at $18.0B and Shield AI at $12.7B). The divergence between peer median and stage-progression reflects heterogeneity in the defense technology cohort and valuation dispersion typical at later stages.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $6.6B, with a median of $4.0B. The current $4.4B valuation sits modestly above the calculated median, positioning Skydio at the high end of this range. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate relative to peers and the sustainability of valuations in a sector exhibiting substantial spread ($1.0B–$18.0B), suggesting material variance in market perception of growth and defensibility across Defense & Security companies.
